origin: Post-review consequence proposed by repo_map, quantitatively sharpened using root's requested exact source-flow composition. This is separate from the frozen plain-translate report and its quantified moment addendum.

1_actual_joint_observation.definitions: For fixed L>2s, K>=3 and the unchanged nonempty open center interval I, observe an actual odd native w through c -> <w,v_K(c)> and c -> <w,D u_K(c)>. The inner product is conjugate-linear in its first slot. For linear recovery interfaces one can conjugate both observations; the norm assertions are unchanged. Put ||O(w)||_sup=max(sup_I|<w,v_K(c)>|,sup_I|<w,D u_K(c)>|).
1_actual_joint_observation.kernel: If O(w)=0, plain-translate annihilator characterization makes w supported on the killed frequency set, and the adjoint identity makes D*w invisible to all even translates. The exact normal decomposition is D*w=Nw-(M3(w)/eta)m, where m=n^2-Proj_span{1,r}(n^2), eta=||m||^2. Nw is supported on the killed set. Since L>2s, all of n=0,1,2 are active. The numerator of m after multiplication by beta+n^2 is a nonzero monic quadratic in n^2, so it cannot vanish at all three active nodes. Therefore M3(w)=0.
1_actual_joint_observation.paid_qualitative_recovery: Thus ker O is contained in ker M3 on the complete actual odd native carrier. Finite dimensionality gives a finite set of centers and a recovery functional for M3 through these two actual observation families; no favorable norm or prescribed center set is inferred. Under complete same-L,K spectral separation, SeparatedSourceVisibility gives M3(w)!=0 for every nonzero odd eigenvector, so this joint family detects each such eigenvector qualitatively. No eigenvector hypothesis is needed for the kernel inclusion itself.

2_exact_hidden_vector_current.source_flow: The previously source-bound exact finite flow is v_K'(c)=-i omega(Du_K(c)+a_K(c)g), omega=2pi/L, g=P_O n^3 and a_K=<m,x_K>/eta for the actual unprojected even coefficient vector x_K. This retains the actual input-normal correction.
2_exact_hidden_vector_current.witness: At each integer L>=26, K=L^4, take the explicit odd hidden vector from the main report and divide it by2. Call it w. Then M3(w)=1 and <w,v_K(c)>=0 for all c. Differentiating this identically zero scalar and using <w,g>=overline(M3(w))=1 gives <w,Du_K(c)>=-a_K(c) EXACTLY. No eigenray or unit-vector identification is used.
2_exact_hidden_vector_current.nonzero: The kernel result forces a_K not to vanish identically at these apertures: otherwise this same w would have O(w)=0 but M3(w)=1. Thus the displayed reciprocal cost is finite for each such aperture, while potentially very large.

3_explicit_recovery_cost.normal_coordinate: In the ordered even normal basis (1,n^2,r), a_K is exactly the n^2 coordinate of G_E^(-1)d_E. The other two normal vectors lie in span{1,r}, so eliminating them leaves the same m/eta coefficient. The quantified addendum gives ||G_E^(-1)||<=400 beta^6 and ||d_E||<=sqrt(3)T2 for L>=4pi. Hence sup_I|a_K|<=400 sqrt(3) beta^6 T2<=800 beta^6 T2.
3_explicit_recovery_cost.quartic: With exactly K=ceil(L^4), the existing source-fixed constants lambda0,C2 give sup_I|a_K|<=800 C2 L^(37/2) exp(-lambda0 L^(3/2)). This uses beta^6<=L^12 and T2<=C2 L^(13/2)exp(-lambda0 sqrt(K/L)). There is no aperture-dependent source or extra analytic premise.
3_explicit_recovery_cost.sup_norm_lower_cost: For each integer L>=26, every bound |M3(w)|<=C_rec ||O(w)||_sup valid on the whole actual odd carrier must satisfy C_rec>=1/sup_I|a_K|>=exp(lambda0 L^(3/2))/(800 C2 L^(37/2)). This follows from the literal M3=1 hidden witness. It is a norm lower bound for cubic recovery on the full carrier, not for a reconstruction map restricted to the unknown actual unit ground.
3_explicit_recovery_cost.finite_hilbert_sampling: For a chosen finite set of centers, with nonnegative weights p_j on the v channel and q_j on the Du channel, let the squared observation norm be sum p_j|<w,v(c_j)>|^2+sum q_j|<w,Du(c_j)>|^2. The same witness has norm at most sqrt(sum q_j) sup|a_K|. Any valid cubic recovery bound therefore costs at least 1/[sqrt(sum q_j) sup|a_K|], unless the sampled observation is zero, in which case recovery is impossible for that sample set. An unweighted m-sample Du channel spends sqrt(m); no dimension-free Hilbert conversion is claimed.

3a_concrete_finite_hilbert_instance.sampling: Fix m=2K+1 centers c_j in I whose phases exp(2pi i c_j/L) are distinct. Such centers exist in any nonempty open I. Define continuous LINEAR maps P_s(w)_j=m^(-1/2)<v_K(c_j),w> and C_s(w)_j=m^(-1/2)<Du_K(c_j),w> into Euclidean complex m-space. Take ell(w)=<g,w>=M3(w). These use the conjugated observations from section1, so their complex linearity is exact.
3a_concrete_finite_hilbert_instance.kernel_proof: Each scalar observation as a function of c is a trigonometric polynomial with frequencies between -K and K. Multiplication by exp(2pi i K c/L) makes it a polynomial of degree at most2K in exp(2pi i c/L). Vanishing at the2K+1 distinct sampled phases therefore implies identically zero. Thus ker P_s intersect ker C_s is contained in ker ell by the actual joint kernel calculation, for this specified finite sampling family, without a continuous-to-discrete norm assumption.
3a_concrete_finite_hilbert_instance.actual_recovery_interface: The hypotheses of Zeta23.OPICAFollowup.joint_recovery_iff and joint_recovery_optimal_norm in current JointObservation.lean are now supplied with E=the actual odd native carrier and Y=H=Euclidean complex m-space. They give a finite Hilbert recovery R on WithLp2(Y times H), recovering ell exactly and attaining the ratio-supremum norm. This paragraph is a DERIVED instantiation of the already compiled generic theorems, not a new Lean-checked consumer.
3a_concrete_finite_hilbert_instance.same_lower_bound: For the exact integer-aperture witness w with M3=1, P_s(w)=0 and C_s(w)_j=-m^(-1/2)overline(a_K(c_j)). Consequently the joint Hilbert norm is sqrt(m^(-1)sum_j|a_K(c_j)|^2)<=sup_I|a_K|. It is nonzero by the paid finite kernel condition. Every recovery R, including the optimal one, therefore satisfies ||R||>=exp(lambda0 L^(3/2))/(800 C2 L^(37/2)). The chosen RMS normalization is explicit; changing it changes the numerical norm. No missing sampling dimension factor is hidden.

4_consequence_and_limits.new_information: The larger genuine source/index family removes the cubic kernel obstruction and qualitatively detects every separated odd eigenmode, while the exact source-normal current prices a superexponential all-carrier recovery cost at the commensurate quartic apertures. This combines positive recovery information with an actual-source conditioning bound.

The cost does not rule out a better estimate on particular actual unit ground rays, additional source/output histories, or a direct signed covariance argument. Neither the full two-center signed covariance nor a closing arithmetic bound is supplied.
